intro.ja:
早繰り銀は３六歩から銀を３七・４六へ進め、３五歩の交換で五段目へ出る。△３四歩で追われても２四歩で銀交換を狙う構想がある。棒銀と似た突破を狙いながら、３筋を空けるので角打ちの隙が増える。仕掛ける前に玉を６八などへ動かす。

居玉で銀交換から２四飛と進むと１五角の王手飛車がある。端歩１六もその筋を消す手になる。相手の８六歩・同歩・８五歩には、もう一度取ると８五飛が銀桂両取りになる場合がある。３四歩と攻め合い、後の８八歩で飛車の侵入を抑える受けも読む。
intro.en:
Rapid Silver advances through 37 to 46 after developing the third-file pawn. A pawn exchange on 35 brings the silver to the fifth rank, where a second-file break can still threaten an exchange even if a pawn drop tries to chase it. Opening the third file also exposes bishop-drop diagonals, so move the king before committing to the attack.

Leaving the king at home can allow a bishop drop on 15 to fork king and rook after the silver exchange. An edge pawn on 16 also covers that drop. Watch the opponent’s successive eighth-file pawn offers: a second capture may allow an 85-rook fork against silver and knight. Consider continuing your own attack while reserving a pawn block against the rook.

question.ja: 銀交換ができても居玉のままなら何を警戒する？
question.en: What must you check even after achieving the intended silver exchange?

answer.ja: １五角などの王手飛車。銀交換の成功だけで攻めが成立したとは言えない。
answer.en: Bishop drops that fork king and rook, especially 15-bishop. The silver exchange alone does not prove the attack works.

courses.title: 角換わり早繰り銀: 図1-1 角換わりの基本形 → 図2-4 銀交換が基本の狙い
courses.titleEn: Bishop Exchange Rapid Silver: Figure 1-1: Basic form of Bishop Exchange → Figure 2-4: Silver exchange is the basic aim
courses.goalFormation:
図2-4 銀交換が基本の狙い
相手の守りの銀と攻めの銀を交換できれば、早繰り銀の攻めは成功と言えます。ここから、1筋の歩を突き捨てて▲1三歩と打つ端攻めなどの攻め手があります。ここから先の攻め筋も棒銀と似ています。

child.comment:
図2-4 銀交換が基本の狙い
相手の守りの銀と攻めの銀を交換できれば、早繰り銀の攻めは成功と言えます。ここから、1筋の歩を突き捨てて▲1三歩と打つ端攻めなどの攻め手があります。ここから先の攻め筋も棒銀と似ています。
child.commentEn:
Figure 2-4: Silver exchange is the basic aim
If Black can exchange the attacking silver for the opponent's defending silver, the Fast-Moving Silver attack can be called successful. From here there are attacks such as an edge attack: sacrificing the 1st-file pawn and dropping ▲1三歩. The attacking lines from here also resemble Climbing Silver.

section.ja: 銀交換できれば早繰り銀優勢
section.en: If silvers can be exchanged, Rapid Advancing Silver is better

child.comment:
図2-3 銀取りに構わず▲2四歩と攻める
相手は△3四歩と打って銀を追い返そうとしますが、銀取りに構わず▲2四歩と突いて攻める手が成立します。次に△3五歩と銀を取られても、▲2三歩成の攻めが強烈です。銀を五段目に出して銀取りに構わず▲2四歩と突く攻め筋は、棒銀と似ています。
child.commentEn:
Figure 2-3: Ignore the silver threat and attack with ▲2四歩
The opponent drops △3四歩 to drive the silver back, but Black can ignore the threat to the silver and push ▲2四歩. Even if the silver is then captured by △3五歩, the attack ▲2三歩成 is powerful. This attack, bringing the silver to the fifth rank and pushing ▲2四歩 despite the silver being threatened, resembles Climbing Silver.

section.ja: 棒銀のように銀交換を狙う
section.en: Aim for a silver exchange like Rushing Silver

child.comment:
図2-2 銀が五段目に進出
3五の歩を交換しながら、銀を五段目に進出させるのが攻めの狙いです。ここからさらに追撃します。
child.commentEn:
Figure 2-2: The silver advances to the fifth rank
The aim is to exchange the pawn on 3五 while advancing the silver to the fifth rank. Then press the attack further.

section.ja: 棒銀のように銀交換を狙う
section.en: Aim for a silver exchange like Rushing Silver

child.comment:
図2-1 ▲3五歩から仕掛ける
早繰り銀の基本の仕掛けは、▲3五歩と3筋の歩をぶつける手です。さらに進めて攻め筋を見ます。
child.commentEn:
Figure 2-1: Open the attack with ▲3五歩
The basic attack of Fast-Moving Silver is to confront with the 3rd-file pawn by ▲3五歩. Continue to see the attacking lines.

child.comment:
図1-2 ▲4六銀とするのが早繰り銀
▲3六歩と突き、銀を3七から4六へと進めていくのが早繰り銀の陣形です。この形からどう攻めていくかを見ます。
child.commentEn:
Figure 1-2: ▲4六銀 is Rapid Advancing Silver
Pushing ▲3六歩 and moving the silver from 3七 to 4六 is the Fast-Moving Silver formation. We see how to attack from this form.

section.ja: 銀を3七~4六と使うのが早繰り銀
section.en: Using the silver on 3七 then 4六 is Rapid Advancing Silver

root.comment:
図1-1 角換わりの基本形
図1-1は角換わりの基本形です。この局面から角換わり早繰り銀の形を目指します。
root.commentEn:
Figure 1-1: Basic form of Bishop Exchange
Diagram 1-1 is the basic form of Bishop Exchange. From this position, aim for the Bishop Exchange Fast-Moving Silver formation.

courses.title: 角換わり早繰り銀: 図1-2 ▲4六銀とするのが早繰り銀 → 図3-3 王手飛車で敗着
courses.titleEn: Bishop Exchange Rapid Silver: Figure 1-2: ▲4六銀 is Rapid Advancing Silver → Figure 3-3: Fatal move: check that forks the king and rook
courses.goalFormation:
図3-3 王手飛車で敗着
△1五角が王手飛車になって敗着です。早繰り銀では3筋の歩を突いていくため、このような角打ちの隙が生じやすくなっています。この王手飛車を避けるため、あらかじめ玉を6八などに寄せてから攻めるのが安全です。また▲1六歩と端の歩を突いておいて△1五角の筋を消す手もよく指されます。

child.comment:
図3-3 王手飛車で敗着
△1五角が王手飛車になって敗着です。早繰り銀では3筋の歩を突いていくため、このような角打ちの隙が生じやすくなっています。この王手飛車を避けるため、あらかじめ玉を6八などに寄せてから攻めるのが安全です。また▲1六歩と端の歩を突いておいて△1五角の筋を消す手もよく指されます。
child.commentEn:
Figure 3-3: Fatal move: check that forks the king and rook
△1五角 is a double attack on king and rook and decides the game. Since Fast-Moving Silver pushes the 3rd-file pawn, such bishop-drop weaknesses arise easily. To avoid this, it is safe to move the king to something like 6八 before attacking. Pushing the edge pawn ▲1六歩 beforehand to remove the △1五角 line is also often played.

section.ja: 王手飛車の反撃で敗勢に
section.en: A check-and-rook fork counterattack turns the game into a loss

child.comment:
図3-2 攻めが好調に見えるが…？
先ほどと同じ手順で、攻めの銀と守りの銀を交換しました。一見、早繰り銀が気持ちよく攻めていますが、ここで相手に反撃の一手があります。
child.commentEn:
Figure 3-2: The attack looks good, but...?
With the same sequence, the attacking silver and the defending silver were exchanged. Fast-Moving Silver seems to be attacking well, but the opponent has a counterattacking move here.

section.ja: 王手飛車の反撃で敗勢に
section.en: A check-and-rook fork counterattack turns the game into a loss

child.comment:
図3-1 居玉のまま攻めると？
図1-2に戻り、早繰り銀の失敗パターンを見ます。先ほどの攻めとほとんど同じ形に見えますが、玉が居玉のまま攻めると思わぬ落とし穴があります。
child.commentEn:
Figure 3-1: What if attacking with the king unmoved?
Return to Diagram 1-2 and see a failing pattern for Fast-Moving Silver. It looks almost the same as the earlier attack, but attacking with the king still on its starting square (i-gyoku) has an unexpected pitfall.

section.en: Attacking with the king at home is bad

root.comment:
図1-2 ▲4六銀とするのが早繰り銀
▲3六歩と突き、銀を3七から4六へと進めていくのが早繰り銀の陣形です。この形からどう攻めていくかを見ます。
root.commentEn:
Figure 1-2: ▲4六銀 is Rapid Advancing Silver
Pushing ▲3六歩 and moving the silver from 3七 to 4六 is the Fast-Moving Silver formation. We see how to attack from this form.

courses.title: 角換わり早繰り銀: 図2-2 銀が五段目に進出 → 図4-3 銀桂両取りの十字飛車
courses.titleEn: Bishop Exchange Rapid Silver: Figure 2-2: The silver advances to the fifth rank → Figure 4-3: Cross-shaped rook forking silver and knight
courses.goalFormation:
図4-3 銀桂両取りの十字飛車
△8五歩に▲同歩と取ると、△同飛が銀桂両取りの十字飛車になります。これで早繰り銀側が劣勢になります。

child.comment:
図4-3 銀桂両取りの十字飛車
△8五歩に▲同歩と取ると、△同飛が銀桂両取りの十字飛車になります。これで早繰り銀側が劣勢になります。
child.commentEn:
Figure 4-3: Cross-shaped rook forking silver and knight
If Black takes △8五歩 with ▲同歩, △同飛 becomes a cross-fork of rook attacking silver and knight. The Fast-Moving Silver side then falls behind.

section.ja: ▲同歩と取ると銀桂両取りの十字飛車
section.en: Capturing with ▲ pawn allows a cross-shaped rook fork on silver and knight

child.comment:
図4-2 継ぎ歩の手筋
▲同歩と歩を取ると、相手はさらに△8五歩と継ぎ歩の手筋を使ってきました。この狙いは何でしょうか。まず素直に▲同歩と取るとどうなるか見ます。
child.commentEn:
Figure 4-2: The tsugi-fu tesuji
If Black takes with ▲同歩, the opponent uses the successive-pawn tesuji with another △8五歩. What is the aim? First see what happens if Black simply takes with ▲同歩.

section.en: What is the aim of the △8五歩 connecting pawn?

child.comment:
図4-1 相手の攻めの狙いは？
図2-2に戻り、相手が反撃してくる順を見ます。先ほどは△3四歩と打ってきましたが、銀取りを無視して▲2四歩と攻めれば早繰り銀が優勢でした。今度は△3四歩に代わって△8六歩と相手も攻めてきます。これに▲同銀と取ると、△5五角で飛車香両取りになるので注意が必要です。
child.commentEn:
Figure 4-1: What is the opponent's attack aiming at?
Return to Diagram 2-2 and see the lines where the opponent counterattacks. Before, White dropped △3四歩, and ignoring the threat to the silver with ▲2四歩 favored Fast-Moving Silver. Now instead of △3四歩, White attacks with △8六歩. If Black takes with ▲同銀, △5五角 forks rook and lance, so be careful.

section.ja: 銀が五段目に出たタイミングは注意
section.en: Be careful of the timing when the silver reaches the fifth rank

図2-2 銀が五段目に進出
3五の歩を交換しながら、銀を五段目に進出させるのが攻めの狙いです。ここからさらに追撃します。

courses.title: 角換わり早繰り銀: 図4-2 継ぎ歩の手筋 → 図4-5 早繰り銀側が指しやすい
courses.titleEn: Bishop Exchange Rapid Silver: Figure 4-2: The tsugi-fu tesuji → Figure 4-5: Rapid Advancing Silver side has the easier game
courses.goalFormation:
図4-5 早繰り銀側が指しやすい
図4-5の局面では、早繰り銀側の銀が相手玉の近くまで迫っています。ここから持ち駒の角と歩でうまく攻めをつなげられるかが勝負のカギです。

child.comment:
図4-5 早繰り銀側が指しやすい
図4-5の局面では、早繰り銀側の銀が相手玉の近くまで迫っています。ここから持ち駒の角と歩でうまく攻めをつなげられるかが勝負のカギです。
child.commentEn:
Figure 4-5: Rapid Advancing Silver side has the easier game
In Diagram 4-5 the Fast-Moving Silver side's silver is close to the opponent's king. The key is whether the attack can be connected skillfully with the bishop and pawn in hand.

section.ja: 継ぎ歩を手抜いて▲3四歩で攻め合う
section.en: Ignore the tsugi-fu and counterattack with ▲3四歩

child.comment:
図4-4 こちらも攻め合う
△8五歩に▲同歩と取ると失敗なので、図4-2に戻って別の手を考えます。ここでは▲3四歩と攻め合いましょう。△8六歩と歩を取り込まれても、▲8八歩と打てばすぐには相手の攻めがないので、ここは相手の攻めを無視するのが良い手になります。
child.commentEn:
Figure 4-4: Counterattack as well
Taking △8五歩 with ▲同歩 fails, so return to Diagram 4-2 and consider another move. Here race with ▲3四歩. Even if White takes the pawn with △8六歩, dropping ▲8八歩 leaves White without an immediate attack, so ignoring the opponent's attack is the good move.

section.ja: 継ぎ歩を手抜いて▲3四歩で攻め合う
section.en: Ignore the tsugi-fu and counterattack with ▲3四歩
